newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama to award hydroelectric project in March.
newsitem.headline: Panama to award hydroelectric project in March.

text.p: Panama will award in March the contract for the country's second largest hydro-electric power station from among four bidders, a government spokesman said.

The government opened sealed bids Friday from four international consortiums to build a $300 million, 132-megawatt dam in western Chiriqui provice, 150 miles (240 km) from the capital, a spokesman with the Institute of Water Resources and Electricity (IRHE) said.

The bidders are Mexico's Empresas ICA Sociedad Controladora SA de CV, which presented the lowest bid of $229.5 million, Swedish construction group Skanska AB, German industrialist giant Siemens AG and Italian construction group Impregilo.
A government commission will evaluate the bids and select the winner "in order to ensure that the documents are in order before awarding the contract to the lowest bidder," the spokesman said.
